art_instructions: Draw a medium shot at eye level showing Owl perched on a low wooden windowsill inside the cozy family house. She is in the middle of leaning forward to push open the window with her wing, preparing to leave. Her round amber eyes are alert and focused, with small feathery tufts atop her head. She wears her signature tiny green scarf tied neatly at her neck. Her tiny satchel rests on her back. The interior of the house is visible behind her: warm wooden walls, a soft green cushion on a nearby chair, and cream-colored curtains gently blowing from the open window. Owl's posture shows motion, with one wing extended and her body angled outward toward the opening. The lighting is warm and natural, filling the scene with a gentle morning glow.
